Description: Vaccination of susceptible children through an un-monitored program at rate xU.
Vaccination of susceptible children through a monitored program at rate xM.
Maturation of susceptible children into susceptible adults at rate j.
Infection of susceptible children upon contact with infectious children or adults at rate bC.
Breakthrough infection of un-monitored vaccinated children due to incomplete vaccine effectiveness (e) at rate bC.
Development of full immunity in un-monitored vaccinated children at rate hU.
Maturation of un-monitored vaccinated children into un-monitored vaccinated adults at rate j.
Development of full immunity in monitored vaccinated children at rate hM.
Progression from exposed to infectious state after the incubation period at rate d.
Maturation of exposed children into exposed adults at rate j.
Recovery of infectious children, leading to immunity, at rate g.
Maturation of infectious children into infectious adults at rate j.
Maturation of immune children into immune adults at rate j.
Vaccination of susceptible adults through a catch-up program at rate xA.
Infection of susceptible adults upon contact with infectious children or adults at rate bA.
Development of full immunity in un-monitored vaccinated adults at rate hA.

Name: L
Description: Recruitment rate to children group.

Name: xU
Description: Un-monitored children vaccination rate.

Name: xM
Description: Monitored children vaccination rate.

Name: xA
Description: Adult vaccination rate.

Name: bC
Description: Transmission rate in children.

Name: bA
Description: Transmission rate in adults.

Name: m
Description: Natural death rate.

Name: g
Description: Rate of being immune after recovery from infection.

Name: j
Description: Maturation rate from child to adult.

Name: e
Description: Vaccine failure proportion, where (1-e) is vaccine effectiveness.

Name: hA
Description: Rate of becoming immune for vaccinated adults (both un-monitored and monitored).

Name: hU
Description: Rate of becoming immune for un-monitored vaccinated children.

Name: hM
Description: Rate of becoming immune for monitored vaccinated children.

Name: d
Description: Rate of progression from exposed to infectious (1/incubation period).
